job_location: Netherlands (hybrid — office in Amsterdam centrum, home, and client sites)

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Schrijven van (complexe) SQL en Python voor data-extractie, transformatie en kwaliteitsborging
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Data quality assurance ('kwaliteitsborging') and consistent semantic layer definitions balance against 'sneller en beter werken' (faster and better) framing around AI tools, giving mixed weight to both.
evidence.domain_risk: Opleveren van schone Gold-laag datasets als databron voor o.a. Tableau, Sigma Computing en Power BI
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: This is a data consultancy serving multiple client businesses without a named regulated sector or financial-reporting/audit language, placing this at moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The JD describes an established Medallion-architecture practice with named partner-tier tooling (Snowflake, dbt, Tableau) already in production use across clients, indicating a growing but already-functioning practice rather than a from-zero build.
evidence.jd_authorship: Bouwen en onderhouden van schaalbare datamodellen en pipelines in dbt en Snowflake op basis van de Medallion architectuur (Bronze, Silver, Gold)
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise methodology (Medallion architecture, Bronze/Silver/Gold layers, semantic layer definitions) and specific tools (dbt, Snowflake, Tableau, Sigma Computing, Power BI, Claude, GitHub Copilot), showing exactly what the role does day to day.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Samenwerken met business analisten en klanten om databehoefte te vertalen naar technische oplossingen
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role centers on building the data modelling/semantic layer for internal data consumers (business analysts) and clients broadly, an internal-data orientation rather than one specific commercial, product, or finance function.
evidence.autonomy_level: Bouwen en onderhouden van schaalbare datamodellen en pipelines in dbt en Snowflake
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: All responsibilities are scoped execution verbs (bouwen, onderhouden, definiëren, opleveren, schrijven, inzetten, samenwerken, opbouwen) responding to defined client/business needs rather than setting new strategic direction.
evidence.ai_role: Actief inzetten van AI-tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot) om sneller en beter te werken
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to actively use AI coding tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate their own data engineering work, the defining signal of ai_user.
evidence.testing_framing: Kennis van datamodellering en de Medallion architectuur
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality assurance ('kwaliteitsborging') is named as part of a responsibility but without a specific named testing framework or explicit ownership verb tied to a testing practice, landing as tool_listed/general rather than a defined testing responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely in delivery/capability terms (building datasets, defining semantics, using AI tools) with no risk, compliance, or reliability register present.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Definiëren van de semantische laag: KPI's, metrics en bedrijfslogica eenmalig en consistent vastleggen in code
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD mixes new-build language (definiëren, opbouwen, bouwen) with maintain language (onderhouden) roughly evenly across a Medallion-architecture pipeline, making this mixed.
evidence.language_gate: Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels
evidence.work_arrangement: Hybride werken vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam centrum, thuis en bij klanten
ats_keywords: Tableau, Sigma Computing en Power BI
